elections.name: City of Nanaimo general local election

locations: Beban Park Social Centre, 2300 Bowen Road
Beban Park Social Centre, 2300 Bowen Road

elections.howToVote: Eligible City of Nanaimo voters can vote at any of 11 voting places on General Voting Day (Saturday, Oct. 17, 8 a.m.-8 p.m.), at advance voting at Beban Park Social Centre on Oct. 7 or Oct. 14, or by mail ballot (apply by 4 p.m. Oct. 16; ballots must be received by 8 p.m. Oct. 17). Voters who are not already registered can register at the voting place with two pieces of ID that together prove identity and residence, at least one with a signature; non-resident property electors also need proof of property ownership and, if applicable, written consent of the majority of owners.

elections.name: School District 68 (Nanaimo-Ladysmith) trustee election
elections.appliesTo: All of the City of Nanaimo. SD68 elects 9 trustees at large across the whole school district (City of Nanaimo plus Ladysmith, Lantzville and RDN Electoral Areas A, B, C and E), so every Nanaimo voter may vote for up to 9 trustee candidates.

locations: Beban Park Social Centre, 2300 Bowen Road (City of Nanaimo advance voting place)
Beban Park Social Centre, 2300 Bowen Road (City of Nanaimo advance voting place)

elections.howToVote: School trustees are elected on the same day as the municipal election (Saturday, Oct. 17). Nanaimo-Ladysmith Public Schools runs its own trustee election; news coverage reports the same advance voting dates (Oct. 7 and 14). Check the SD68 election page or contact the district to confirm where City of Nanaimo residents receive their trustee ballot.
